::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [after 1866]  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection
:::

Dear [Miss Phillpotts](people/person_1171.qmd),
It seems hardly fair to have kept your paper several days, when the [Monthly Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd) is obliged to 'draw a line' against the numerous Missionary Papers it might have, but I wanted to show it to [Miss Crawley](people/person_382.qmd) - who you know, as well as [Miss Morshead](people/person_28.qmd) was one of the first Sisters.

She begged to keep a copy of it, and I think it would be most advisable to publish it. I was thinking of sending it to the [Literary Churchman](organizations/other_76.qmd)

Yours truly
C M Yonge

Looking again at your note I see you design it for the [Net](organizations/other_94.qmd)as the next choice, so here it is.
